deliverable: Repair lane M1 (admission core) for these review findings: (1) Slot files are created with writeFileSync flag 'wx', which makes the file visible empty before its JSON is written; a concurrent reader then sees an unparseable file, treats it as stale and unlinks it, so two runs hold one slot. Write the JSON to a unique temp file in the same directory, then linkSync(tmp, slotPath) (EEXIST means taken), then unlink the temp; additionally treat an unparseable slot file as live unless its mtime is older than 60 s on the injected clock. (2) Stale-slot reclaim races: two waiters that both saw a dead pid can each unlink, the second deleting the first's fresh slot. Reclaim by renameSync(slot, '<slot>.stale-<holder>-<pid>-<n>'); only the process whose rename succeeds re-reads the renamed file, confirms the pid is still the dead one, and deletes it; if the renamed file holds a live pid (it was fresh), rename it back with linkSync and treat the slot as held. (3) An empty JUNIOR_STATE_DIR must fall back to ~/.junior (use || not ??). (4) Pass req.signal to the 1 s swap-out sample sleep so an abort during the sample returns E_ADMISSION_INTERRUPTED promptly. (5) JUNIOR_ADMISSION=off is honoured by resolveMachineConfig (enabled:false); admit itself obeys only config.enabled, so tests that pass an explicit config still exercise it. Read the environment through an injectable env (resolveMachineConfig(cwd, task, env = process.env)). Add one behavioural test per item.
acceptance: a slot file is never visible to other processes before its JSON is complete
an unparseable fresh slot file is not reclaimed
two concurrent reclaims of one stale slot leave exactly one holder
an empty JUNIOR_STATE_DIR does not create admission state in the current directory
an abort during the pressure sample returns E_ADMISSION_INTERRUPTED
constraints: Work only inside the current working directory; no commits or pushes; no nested workers
Keep everything the first pass did that these findings do not name
Every new or changed test is an atomic scenario with a declarative name and exactly one behavioural assertion against a public outcome
Any time logic reads the injected clock (clock.ts); never Date.now(), new Date() or global timers in production code
Tests never read the real /proc, the real home directory or the network; inject procRoot, stateDir and spawn
Do not run the full npm test suite; run only this contract's checks
